roadmap.title: Finish the story on any difficulty
roadmap.description: Play the campaign normally. During the opening Rhino ride, break 15 mall objects; during Like Real Scientists, beat Phin at the rocket game. Both sequences remain recoverable through mission replay.

roadmap.title: Complete Manhattan and clean up combat
roadmap.description: Use post-story free roam to clear every district checklist, then replay bases and trainings for stealth, gadget, Venom, combo, and rating achievements. Finish the graves, statue, boat, Photo Mode, and Social Feed objectives.

roadmap.title: Finish New Game+ and remaining progression
roadmap.description: Create New Game+ from the completed save, craft the Spider-Training Suit, reach level 23 and buy the final three skills, then replay the main story through the ending.

achievements.summary: Unlock every one of the other 49 Steam achievements.

guide.context: The full set includes New Game+ completion, every skill, and every required suit, so Be Yourself cannot register during the first campaign.

steps.text: Complete the story, all district activities, combat counters, and miscellaneous objectives on the original save.
Start New Game+, buy the final skill in each of the three skill trees, craft the Spider-Training Suit, and complete the second campaign.
Unlock the last remaining non-platinum achievement and wait for @mechanic{Be Yourself} to register automatically.

achievements.summary: Unlock all 33 skills by completing the nine Spider-Training Challenges and buying every level-based skill in New Game+.

guide.context: Nine challenge skills are awarded directly by Spider-Training. The other 24 use skill points; three of those remain locked until New Game+, whose level cap rises from 20 to 30.

steps.text: Complete all nine @mechanic{Spider-Training Challenges} once to receive the nine challenge skills.
Spend skill points on every available Combat, Venom, and Camouflage skill during the first playthrough.
Begin New Game+, earn experience until at least level 23, and open the @mechanic{Skills} menu.
Purchase the final New Game+ skill at the bottom of each of the three skill trees so all 33 entries are unlocked.

achievements.summary: Raise every Manhattan district to 100% by finishing the story and every map-checklist activity.

guide.context: Postcards appear only after the campaign, and several other categories unlock gradually. A district that reads 100% early can gain new checklist entries after later story milestones.

steps.text: Complete the main story, return to Miles’s home, and begin @loc{Memory Lane} so Postcards enter the district checklists.

Complete all nine Spider-Training Challenges and 10 FNSM requests. Collect 16 Time Capsules, 35 Underground Caches, eight Postcards, and 10 Sound Samples; also finish the six enemy bases and nine side missions.
Open the Map and confirm that every district checklist and the overall completion display read 100%.

achievements.summary: Open the story-linked Time Capsule during Reconnecting, then collect the 15 map pickups unlocked afterward.

guide.context: The 15 free-roam icons appear after Miles and Phin’s story capsule in Reconnecting. One later capsule sits on the derelict Chinatown boat needed for a separate achievement.

steps.text: Complete the story-linked @mechanic{Time Capsule} sequence in @loc{Reconnecting} to add the other 15 capsule icons to the Map.
Select each Time Capsule icon and use the proximity marker to locate its container.
Open all 16 Time Capsules and confirm that the map counter reaches 16/16.

achievements.summary: After the story, start Memory Lane at Miles’s home and collect all eight Postcards in sequence.

guide.context: The first Postcard comes from starting the side mission. Each card’s written clue creates the next pink search area, so the collection must be followed in order rather than cleared from pre-existing icons.

steps.text: Finish the campaign, return to @loc{Miles’s home}, and accept the @loc{Memory Lane} side mission to receive the first Postcard.
Read each Postcard clue, travel to the pink search area, and use the scanner to highlight the next card.
Follow the chain until all eight Postcards have been collected and the Memory Lane route concludes.

achievements.summary: Open all 35 Underground Caches: 29 in free roam and one inside each of the three Roxxon Labs and three Underground Hideouts.

guide.context: The six base caches sit on alternate routes before their main combat arenas. A missed base cache can be collected through mission replay, and its pickup remains saved even if the replay is exited afterward.

steps.text: Track and open the 29 @mechanic{Underground Cache} icons found in open-world districts.
Replay each of the three Roxxon Labs, scan before entering the combat arena, and open the cache along the alternate route.
Repeat the scan-and-search process in all three Underground Hideouts, then confirm the total reaches 35/35.

achievements.summary: Infiltrate and shut down all three Roxxon Labs marked on the Map.

guide.context: Labs unlock through story progress and can be replayed. Each lab also contains one of the six base-only Underground Caches, positioned before the main encounter.

steps.text: Advance the story until red @mechanic{Roxxon Lab} icons begin appearing.
Enter each lab, complete its infiltration and combat objectives, and shut down its reactor or terminal.
Complete all three Roxxon Labs and confirm each icon shows as cleared.

achievements.summary: Infiltrate and shut down all three Underground Hideouts marked on the Map.

guide.context: Hideouts unlock through story progress and can be replayed. Each contains an Underground Cache on an alternate route before the main enemy arena.

steps.text: Advance the story until red @mechanic{Underground Hideout} icons appear.
Enter each hideout, defeat its Underground forces, and complete the closing objective.
Complete all three Underground Hideouts and confirm every icon shows as cleared.

achievements.summary: Unlock and craft all 19 required suits on one save, including the Spider-Training Suit in New Game+.

guide.context: Several suits come from story or side missions rather than crafting. The final required Spider-Training Suit becomes available only after starting New Game+, so first-playthrough completion is impossible.

steps.text: Complete the story, every side mission, and all nine Spider-Training Challenges to receive their suit rewards.
Open @mechanic{Suits} and spend Activity Tokens and Tech Parts on every remaining first-playthrough suit.
Start New Game+, open the Suits menu, and craft the newly available @item{Spider-Training Suit} so all 19 required suits are owned on that save.

achievements.description: Unravel a criminal conspiracy in Harlem
achievements.summary: Complete Harlem’s side missions, then finish the unlocked We’ve Got a Lead! finale.

guide.context: The Harlem chain becomes available gradually through story progress. Completing its earlier missions reveals We’ve Got a Lead! and also awards the Winter Suit.

steps.text: Complete every available side mission in @loc{Harlem} as its markers appear.
After the earlier Harlem missions are finished, track the new @loc{We’ve Got a Lead!} marker.
Complete every objective in We’ve Got a Lead! until the criminal-conspiracy storyline closes.

achievements.description: Complete an Enemy Base without being detected
achievements.summary: Finish one Roxxon Lab or Underground Hideout without any enemy reaching the red-alert state.

guide.context: A yellow suspicion marker is allowed; a red exclamation mark means detection and invalidates the attempt. Bases remain replayable, and reloading the latest checkpoint immediately after detection preserves the run.

steps.text: Replay a cleared @mechanic{Roxxon Lab} or Underground Hideout on the lowest difficulty.
Use ceilings, walls, Remote Mines, and @mechanic{Camouflage} while attacking only enemies labelled Safe.
If any enemy displays a red exclamation mark, reload the latest checkpoint before continuing.
Defeat the final enemy and complete the base objective without triggering red alert.

achievements.summary: Reach a 100-hit combo during one combat encounter without letting the combo timer expire.

guide.context: On the lowest difficulty, taking damage does not reset the counter, although a long pause still does. Replayable Roxxon Labs and Underground Hideouts provide enough enemies for the streak.

steps.text: Set the lowest difficulty and replay a Roxxon Lab or Underground Hideout with a large enemy group.
Use normal attacks, launchers, dodges, and web pulls while keeping at least one enemy active.
Move immediately between targets so the combo timer never expires.
Continue until the on-screen combo counter reaches 100 during the same encounter.

achievements.description: Get Spectacular or better in a Spider-Training Traversal Challenge
achievements.summary: Earn a Spectacular-or-better rating in any Spider-Training Traversal Challenge.

guide.context: There are three Traversal challenges, and Spectacular is the second-highest medal. The first 1.0 challenge is the simplest place to learn the scoring condition.

steps.text: Track a @mechanic{Spider-Training Traversal Challenge}; choose the first 1.0 course for the most direct route.
Complete the displayed timed or scoring objective quickly enough to cross the Spectacular threshold.
Reach the results screen and confirm that the awarded rating is Spectacular or Ultimate.

achievements.description: Get Spectacular or better in a Spider-Training Combat Challenge
achievements.summary: Earn a Spectacular-or-better rating in any Spider-Training Combat Challenge.

guide.context: There are three Combat challenges, and Spectacular is the second-highest medal. The first 1.0 challenge is the simplest place to learn the scoring condition.

steps.text: Track a @mechanic{Spider-Training Combat Challenge}; choose the first 1.0 course for the most direct route.
Complete the displayed timed or scoring objective quickly enough to cross the Spectacular threshold.
Reach the results screen and confirm that the awarded rating is Spectacular or Ultimate.

achievements.description: Get Spectacular or better in a Spider-Training Stealth Challenge
achievements.summary: Earn a Spectacular-or-better rating in any Spider-Training Stealth Challenge.

guide.context: There are three Stealth challenges, and Spectacular is the second-highest medal. The first 1.0 challenge is the simplest place to learn the scoring condition.

steps.text: Track a @mechanic{Spider-Training Stealth Challenge}; choose the first 1.0 course for the most direct route.
Complete the displayed timed or scoring objective quickly enough to cross the Spectacular threshold.
Reach the results screen and confirm that the awarded rating is Spectacular or Ultimate.

achievements.summary: Finish all nine Spider-Training Challenges: three Traversal, three Combat, and three Stealth.

guide.context: Any result counts for overall completion; Spectacular medals are needed only for the three separate rating achievements. Clearing the full set also unlocks the Final Test side mission.

steps.text: Complete the three @mechanic{Traversal} Spider-Training Challenges with any result.
Complete the three @mechanic{Combat} Spider-Training Challenges with any result.
Complete the three @mechanic{Stealth} Spider-Training Challenges with any result.
Confirm that all nine challenge icons show as completed.

achievements.summary: Complete all nine Spider-Training Challenges, then finish the Final Test side mission in Greenwich.

guide.context: Final Test appears only after every training icon is cleared. Completing the mission also awards the Miles Morales 2020 Suit.

steps.text: Finish all nine @mechanic{Spider-Training Challenges} once, regardless of medal.
Travel to the newly revealed @loc{Final Test} side-mission marker in Greenwich.
Complete the holographic encounter and its closing objective.

achievements.summary: Craft any 10 gadget upgrades from the Gadgets menu.

guide.context: The four gadgets have 16 upgrades across the original game and New Game+. Ten are enough, so this achievement can be finished with first-playthrough upgrade tiers.

steps.text: Complete activities and open Underground Caches to earn Activity Tokens and Tech Parts.
Open the pause menu, select @mechanic{Gadgets}, and inspect the four gadget upgrade trees.
Purchase any 10 upgrade nodes and confirm that the crafted-upgrade count reaches 10.

achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory Rhino ride through the shopping mall during @loc{Hold Onto Your Web-Shooters}.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the Rhino ride through the shopping mall begins.
Complete every marked objective in the Rhino ride through the shopping mall and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.description: Collect all Sound Samples and recreate the Davis Brothers Mix
achievements.summary: Collect the nine field Sound Samples, then finish Back at the Beginning to create the tenth sample, the Davis Brothers Mix.

guide.context: Breaking Through the Noise provides the first sample and reveals the district locations. Each recording requires Miles to match the correct object, distance, and viewing angle; the Central Park pigeons must be approached while Camouflaged.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Breaking Through the Noise} and record its red-buoy sample to reveal the remaining Sound Sample icons.
At each of the eight district icons, enter Sampling Mode and adjust position and aim until the waveform aligns, then record the target sound.
For the Central Park sample, activate @mechanic{Camouflage} before approaching and record the pigeons without making them fly away.
After all nine field samples, complete @loc{Back at the Beginning} in Harlem and open the hideout locker to recreate the Davis Brothers Mix.

achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory bridge rescue and stabilization sequence during the main story.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the bridge rescue and stabilization sequence begins.
Complete every marked objective in the bridge rescue and stabilization sequence and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory Roxxon underground-lab investigation during the main story.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the Roxxon underground-lab investigation begins.
Complete every marked objective in the Roxxon underground-lab investigation and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.description: Complete the vault sequence in Underground Undercover
achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory vault infiltration sequence during @loc{Underground Undercover}.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the vault infiltration sequence begins.
Complete every marked objective in the vault infiltration sequence and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory subway restoration sequence during @loc{Harlem Trains Out of Service}.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the subway restoration sequence begins.
Complete every marked objective in the subway restoration sequence and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory Tinkerer chase through the city during the main story.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the Tinkerer chase through the city begins.
Complete every marked objective in the Tinkerer chase through the city and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.description: Walk through Miles and Phin’s past
achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory Miles-and-Phin flashback sequence during the main story.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the Miles-and-Phin flashback sequence begins.
Complete every marked objective in the Miles-and-Phin flashback sequence and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory Roxxon Rhino boss fight during @loc{Tinker Tailor Spider Spy}.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the Roxxon Rhino boss fight begins.
Complete every marked objective in the Roxxon Rhino boss fight and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory Prowler boss fight during @loc{Thicker Than Blood}.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the Prowler boss fight begins.
Complete every marked objective in the Prowler boss fight and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory campaign finale during @loc{The Battle for Harlem}.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the campaign finale begins.
Complete every marked objective in the campaign finale and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.summary: Perform 25 stealth takedowns while Miles is attached to a ceiling.

guide.context: The counter accumulates across encounters and mission replays. Roxxon Labs have reusable stealth rooms with suitable walls and ceilings.

steps.text: Replay a Roxxon Lab and remain unseen in its opening stealth room.
Crawl onto a ceiling directly above or beside an isolated enemy.
Scan the target and wait until the takedown indicator reads Safe.
Use the prompted Ceiling Takedown and repeat through replays until 25 register.

achievements.summary: Perform 25 stealth takedowns while Miles is attached to a wall.

guide.context: The counter accumulates across encounters and mission replays. Roxxon Labs have reusable stealth rooms with suitable walls and ceilings.

steps.text: Replay a Roxxon Lab and remain unseen in its opening stealth room.
Crawl onto a wall directly above or beside an isolated enemy.
Scan the target and wait until the takedown indicator reads Safe.
Use the prompted Wall Takedown and repeat through replays until 25 register.

achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies while Miles’s Camouflage is active.

guide.context: The defeating blow must land before the Camouflage meter empties, but it does not need to be a stealth takedown. Combat takedowns qualify while Miles remains invisible.

steps.text: Advance through the early story until @mechanic{Camouflage} becomes available.
Damage enemies normally until they are close to defeat, then let the Camouflage meter recharge.
Activate Camouflage and defeat the weakened enemies before the meter empties.
Repeat in Crimes, bases, or mission replays until 50 Camouflaged defeats register.

achievements.summary: Use Miles’s bio-electric Venom attacks to deliver the final blow to 100 enemies.

guide.context: Each Venom move consumes at least one yellow Venom bar. Damage from other attacks is allowed, but the qualifying Venom attack must defeat the target.

steps.text: Advance the story to unlock Venom Punch, Venom Smash, Venom Jump, Venom Dash, and later Venom moves.
Attack and dodge during combat until at least one yellow Venom bar is full.
Weaken an enemy, then use a Venom attack as the defeating blow.
Repeat across the story, Crimes, bases, and replays until 100 Venom defeats register.

achievements.description: Perform a Venom Jump, then a Venom Dash on a single enemy
achievements.summary: Hit one enemy with Venom Jump and, while Miles and the target are airborne, hit that same enemy with Venom Dash.

guide.context: Venom Jump and Venom Dash unlock automatically through the story. The sequence consumes two Venom bars, so both bars must be charged before the first move.

steps.text: Advance the story until both @mechanic{Venom Jump} and @mechanic{Venom Dash} are available.
Enter combat and fill at least two yellow Venom bars.
Use Venom Jump on a durable enemy to launch both Miles and the target.
Before landing, aim at that airborne enemy and use Venom Dash.

achievements.description: Use Venom Dash to throw an enemy into a group of three or more
achievements.summary: Use Venom Dash to launch one enemy into a tightly grouped cluster of at least three other enemies.

guide.context: The thrown enemy must collide with the group; simply activating Venom Dash while four enemies are nearby is insufficient. Replayable bases make it easy to keep a cluster alive.

steps.text: Enter a Roxxon Lab or Underground Hideout and leave at least four enemies active.
Move so one enemy stands between Miles and a tight group of three or more enemies.
Aim through the isolated target toward the cluster and use @mechanic{Venom Dash} so the launched enemy strikes the group.

achievements.displayName: Like a Rhino in a China Shop
achievements.description: Smash into 15 breakable objects while steering Rhino through the shopping mall
achievements.summary: During the opening mall ride, steer Rhino through at least 15 windows, tables, kiosks, or other breakable objects.

guide.context: The sequence occurs in Hold Onto Your Web-Shooters. Missing the count is recoverable because the completed mission can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Begin or replay @loc{Hold Onto Your Web-Shooters} and continue until Miles lands on Rhino inside the mall.
Steer away from the open center path and line Rhino up with windows, tables, kiosks, and displays.
Crash through at least 15 breakable objects before the ride leaves the shopping mall.

achievements.description: Beat Phin at the rocket launch mini-game
achievements.summary: During Like Real Scientists, win the two-rocket button-mashing game against Phin in the second Oscorp exhibition hall.

guide.context: The rocket display is on the left after the aquarium, during the childhood flashback. If the activity is missed or lost, Like Real Scientists can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Begin or replay @loc{Like Real Scientists} and continue to the childhood visit inside the Oscorp Science Center.
After leaving the aquarium and entering the second exhibition hall, turn left toward the display with two model rockets.
Use the prompt at the rocket exhibit to begin the mini-game with @npc{Phin}.
Press the displayed action repeatedly until Miles’s rocket reaches the top before Phin’s rocket.

achievements.description: Pay your respects to a legend in the Upper West Side
achievements.summary: Interact with the Stan Lee statue beside Mick’s Diner in the Upper West Side.

guide.context: The statue stands between Mick’s Diner and the neighboring market. It is not a normal map activity, but the scanner highlights the interactable when Miles is nearby.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Upper West Side} and locate Mick’s Diner beside the outdoor market.
Use the scanner between the diner and market to highlight the @npc{Stan Lee statue}.
Approach the statue and use the interaction prompt until Miles finishes paying tribute.

achievements.description: Apply a sticker and customise lighting while in Photo Mode
achievements.summary: In Photo Mode, apply any sticker and change any lighting setting from its default value.

guide.context: Taking or saving a photograph is unnecessary. Both edits must be made in the same Photo Mode session before returning to gameplay.

steps.text: Pause during free roam and select @mechanic{Photo Mode}.
Open the Lighting controls and change any value from its default setting.
Open the Sticker controls and place any sticker on the image.
Return to gameplay after both changes are active.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies with the Remote Mine gadget
achievements.summary: Use Remote Mine explosions to deliver the final blow to 50 enemies.

guide.context: The Remote Mine can be fired directly at an enemy. Weakening targets first helps ensure that the mine’s discharge delivers the defeating blow.

steps.text: Purchase @mechanic{Remote Mine} from the Gadgets menu.
In a base or Spider-Training replay, weaken several enemies without defeating them.
Aim at a weakened enemy and fire the Remote Mine directly at that target so its discharge delivers the defeating blow.
Repeat until Remote Mine explosions have defeated 50 enemies.

achievements.summary: Complete all 10 FNSM App requests listed in the app’s Activities tab.

guide.context: Requests unlock gradually and all are available by the end of the story. District Map checklists also show how many requests remain.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{FNSM App} and select its Activities tab.
Choose an available request, travel to its Spider-Man marker, and complete every objective.
Complete all 10 requests and confirm that no activity remains in the app or district checklists.

achievements.summary: Craft any Suit Mod from the Suits menu.

guide.context: Suit Mods use Activity Tokens and Tech Parts earned from map activities. Only one purchase is required, and the mod does not need to remain equipped.

steps.text: Complete early story and district activities until the listed Activity Tokens and Tech Parts are available.
Open @mechanic{Suits}, select the Suit Mod slot, and highlight an affordable locked mod.
Hold the purchase input to craft the selected Suit Mod.

achievements.summary: Craft any Visor Mod from the Suits menu.

guide.context: Visor Mods use Activity Tokens and Tech Parts earned from map activities. Only one purchase is required, and the mod does not need to remain equipped.

steps.text: Complete early story and district activities until the listed Activity Tokens and Tech Parts are available.
Open @mechanic{Suits}, select the Visor Mod slot, and highlight an affordable locked mod.
Hold the purchase input to craft the selected Visor Mod.

achievements.description: Pay respects at Jefferson Davis' grave in Harlem
achievements.summary: Interact with Jefferson Davis’s grave near the northwest corner of Harlem’s cemetery.

guide.context: The grave is available from the beginning and is not a map activity. The scanner outlines the correct headstone; if the respect sequence does not start, leaving the cemetery and returning refreshes the prompt.

steps.text: Travel to the cemetery at the northern edge of @loc{Harlem}.
Search near the cemetery’s northwest corner and use the scanner to highlight @loc{Jefferson Davis’s grave}.
Use the grave’s interaction prompt and remain until Miles finishes paying his respects.

achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory Gift Suit handoff from Peter during the main story.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to linear campaign progress. Difficulty does not affect the unlock, and completed main missions can be replayed from the Missions menu.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign until the Gift Suit handoff from Peter begins.
Complete every marked objective in the Gift Suit handoff from Peter and continue until the next story checkpoint registers.

achievements.description: Complete all Bonus Objectives for every crime type
achievements.summary: Complete both Bonus Objectives for each of the 11 crime types in the FNSM App.

guide.context: The two objectives for a crime type may be completed on separate attempts. Scanning during a crime displays the current requirements, and finished crimes remain replayable from the app.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{FNSM App}, switch to the Crimes tab, and select a crime type.
Start the crime and use the scanner to display its two Bonus Objectives.
Satisfy each objective and finish the crime; replay the crime if the second objective needs a separate attempt.
Repeat until all 11 crime types show both Bonus Objectives as complete.

achievements.summary: Defeat 100 enemies with takedowns while Miles remains undetected.

guide.context: The target indicator must read Safe; a Danger takedown alerts nearby enemies and does not qualify as a stealth takedown. Ceiling, wall, perch, web-strike, and Camouflaged takedowns all contribute.

steps.text: Enter a base or stealth challenge and scan enemies to reveal Safe or Danger labels.
Use a takedown only when the selected enemy reads @mechanic{Safe}.
Move to walls, ceilings, perches, or Camouflage cover after each defeat to remain undetected.
Repeat through story encounters and replayable bases until 100 stealth takedowns register.

achievements.description: Ride the derelict boat in southern Chinatown
achievements.summary: Land on the derelict fishing boat moving beside the southern Chinatown docks.

guide.context: The same boat carries a Time Capsule, so its route is encountered during district completion. The achievement registers as soon as Miles stands on the deck.

steps.text: Travel to the southernmost waterfront in @loc{Chinatown}.
Scan the water for the moving derelict fishing boat and its Time Capsule marker.
Swing or web-zip onto the boat and remain on its deck until the achievement registers.

achievements.description: Scroll through the entire Social Feed at the end of the story
achievements.summary: After finishing the story, open the Social Feed and scroll to its oldest post at the bottom.

guide.context: The feed loads additional posts while scrolling, so reaching a temporary bottom is not always the end. Wait for new entries and continue until no older post appears.

steps.text: Complete @loc{The Battle for Harlem} and wait until post-story free roam resumes.
Open the pause menu and select @mechanic{Social Feed}.
Scroll downward, pause whenever more posts load, and continue to the oldest entry.
Remain at the true bottom until Socially Acceptable registers.

achievements.description: Complete the game on New Game+
achievements.summary: Create New Game+ from a completed save and finish the entire main story again on any difficulty.

guide.context: New Game+ carries existing skills, suits, gadgets, and upgrades into a separate slot. Optional content can be skipped, although a quick Crime may occasionally be needed before the next main mission appears.

steps.text: From the Main Menu save screen, select a free slot and choose @mechanic{New Game+} using the completed campaign save.
Select any difficulty and begin the transferred New Game+ file.
Complete each main mission in order; if the next marker pauses, finish a quick Crime to advance world state.
Complete The Battle for Harlem again and continue until the New Game+ ending registers.
